verdict.rationale: SigNoz's own docs describe one OpenTelemetry-native platform that ingests traces, metrics and logs. They also document cross-signal pivoting: logs correlate with traces and metrics, and any dashboard panel drills down into its underlying logs and traces. Community comments challenge only marketing and benchmark claims, not this capability. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that pivoting works in practice, and detail on the shared-context mechanism (e.g., trace_id linking from the trace view to logs, or metric-to-trace jumps).

support.subject: As an SRE, I can collect metrics, logs, and traces in one platform and pivot between them with shared context

citations.quote: SigNoz Cloud brings your traces, metrics, and logs into one OpenTelemetry-native platform.
Correlate logs with traces and metrics for faster root-cause analysis.
Drill down from any panel: jump into the underlying logs and traces, break out by an attribute
Query logs with blazing fast search and correlate them with traces.
Collect metrics from applications, infrastructure, and existing Prometheus setups.
